name: offertrack
description: A private, local-first desktop job application tracker.
author: OfferTrack contributors

scripts.dev: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next dev
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run db:generate && npm run db:generate:electron && npm run build && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run db:generate && npm run db:generate:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run db:generate && npm run db:generate:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run db:generate && npm run db:generate:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --arm64 --publish never
